name: pjecalc-facil
description: PJE Calc Fácil — API local + interface amigável sobre o PJe-Calc Cidadão (uso pessoal)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,interface -c blue,green "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w interface"
scripts.build: npm run build -w interface && npm run verificar -w api
scripts.test: npm test -w api && npm test -w motor/adaptador
scripts.verificar: npm run verificar -w api && npm run verificar -w interface && npm run verificar -w motor/adaptador
